idle.title: Stopped
idle.message: No regions registered. Start monitoring to detect entries and exits.

regions.title: Waiting
regions.message: {{total}} regions registered with the system. Continuous GPS is off — the device itself is doing the waiting.

precise.title: High precision
precise.message: Inside {{total}} company(ies). Continuous GPS is on to resolve rooms.

blocked.title: Permission needed
blocked.message: Without "always" location access, monitoring cannot work while the app is closed.

startFailed.permissions: Grant background location access to start

mapUnavailable.title: Map unavailable
mapUnavailable.body: The Maps SDK for Android key is missing. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in .env and rebuild the APK. Monitoring works fine without it.

empty.title: No companies yet
empty.body: Register a company, draw its perimeter on the map and mark out the rooms inside it. The app notifies you whenever you walk into any of them.

empty.title: No events yet
empty.body: Start monitoring and walk into one of the companies, or use the simulator to play a route.

editor.deleteBody: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its rooms? Events already recorded stay in the log.
editor.derivedHint: Radius and active radius are derived from the perimeter: the circle is the trigger that wakes the app, and entry itself is decided by the polygon.
editor.outlineRedrawHint: Mark the corners again. Rooms already registered must remain inside the new perimeter.

errors.outlineExcludesRooms: The new perimeter would leave a room outside. Widen the shape or delete the room first.

rooms.title: Rooms ({{total}})
rooms.explainer: Rooms are polygons inside the company. Native circles do not work at this scale — below roughly 100 m iOS stops firing reliably — so they are resolved by point-in-polygon instead.

name.title: Which company?
name.body: The name appears in the entry and exit notifications.

outline.title: Company perimeter
outline.body: Drag the map until the pin sits over a corner of the site and tap "Add point". Repeat for each corner — this way your finger never covers the target.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.body: Now mark out the internal areas. Each becomes its own named polygon and produces a notification when you walk into it.
rooms.emptyBody: You can finish without any: the company already notifies on entering and leaving the perimeter. Rooms can be added later.

roomDraw.title: Room perimeter
roomDraw.body: Same idea: put the pin on each corner of the room. The blue outline is the company perimeter, and the room has to fit inside it.

roomName.title: Room name
roomName.body: This is the name the notification shows.

noPosition.title: No position
noPosition.body: Could not obtain your location. Check the permission and that location services are on.

errors.name: Enter a name with at least 2 characters
errors.area: The area came out too small (minimum {{total}} m²)
errors.outsideCompany: The room has to sit inside the company perimeter
errors.roomName: Enter a name with at least 2 characters
errors.selfIntersecting: The outline crosses itself. Tap "Untangle" or undo the last points.
errors.tooClose: That point sits on top of another one. Pan the map before adding it.

tangled.title: The outline crosses itself
tangled.body: The corners were marked out of order, so the edges cross. That will not do: the inside/outside rule starts treating part of the drawn area as external, and the area comes out wrong.
tangled.hint: Reordering is a suggestion — the app finds an outline without crossings, but the same marks admit more than one shape. Check it on the map; if it is not what you meant, undo the points and mark them again.

wizard.savedButNotMonitoring: Company saved, but monitoring did not start. Check the permissions in Settings.

simulator.title: Simulator
simulator.intro: Feeds a synthetic route through the same pipeline the GPS feeds: same state machine, same deduplication, same notifications. Lets you verify detection without leaving your desk.
simulator.accuracyHint: Readings worse than 100 m are discarded. Company entry is decided by the polygon, so a poor reading delays detection rather than faking it.
simulator.footnote: Positions are dated backwards from now, so real monitoring can resume straight afterwards without waiting.

crossing.label: Walk through
crossing.hint: Enters, crosses the rooms and leaves the far side

approach.label: Arrive and stay
approach.hint: Enters and remains at the centre

monitoringWarning.title: Real monitoring is running
monitoringWarning.body: Simulated positions will interleave with GPS ones. Stop monitoring on the Monitor tab for a clean test.

welcome.title: Geofence Lab
welcome.body: Register a company, draw its perimeter and the rooms inside it. The app tells you every time you enter or leave any of them — with the app open, backgrounded or closed.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Two tiers, so the battery is not spent waiting.
how.bullet1: The operating system watches the nearest companies and wakes the app when you cross one.
how.bullet2: Only then does continuous GPS start, to resolve which room you are in.
how.bullet3: On the way out it stops again — at rest the app requests no position at all.

location.title: Always-on location
location.body: To work while the app is closed, the system requires "always" access. The ordinary prompt comes first, then the background one — on Android that opens a settings page where you must pick "Allow all the time".
location.resultHint: Without background access, detection only works while the app is open. You can grant it later in Settings.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Every entry and exit becomes a local notification — that is how events surface when the app is not on screen. It all works offline.

company.title: Register your company
company.body: Now the main part: marking on the map where the company is.
company.bullet1: A pin fixed at the centre of the screen marks each corner of the perimeter.
company.bullet2: Inside it, you mark out the rooms and name each one.
company.bullet3: It takes under a minute and can be adjusted later.

backgroundMissing.title: No background access
backgroundMissing.body: The system only asks once. After a denial the only way through is to grant it manually in the device settings.

battery.title: Battery optimisation
battery.body: Battery managers from some manufacturers kill the foreground service even when everything is configured correctly. Exempting the app is what keeps monitoring alive with the screen off.

reset.title: Erase everything
reset.body: This stops monitoring and erases companies, rooms, state, events and the message sequence.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.logHint: Background tasks run in a process with no console anyone can read. The log is written to the database so you can see what happened while the app was closed.

messages.title: Messages
messages.intro: Two local notification sequences: onboarding, minutes after signup, and a daily one at a fixed hour. All offline, without duplicates, with delivery confirmations queued for retry.
messages.permissionDenied: Without notification permission there is nothing to schedule

notEnrolled.title: Not enrolled
notEnrolled.body: The whole plan derives from a single instant: the signup. Tap below to record it and schedule the sequence.

receipts.title: Delivery confirmations
receipts.noEndpoint: No endpoint configured. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_ENDPOINT in .env to send confirmations; the queue is recorded locally regardless.
